paper.title: Optimism where there is none: Asymmetric belief updating observed with valence-neutral life events

review.reason: Protocol released from the maintainers' private study as an unreviewed (checked) release: engine checks pass; no independent fidelity review is claimed. The paper does not print every material: no arm runs as published; each arm states its gap and the researcher reconstructs it, labelled reconstructed, before running.
review.reviewScope: Mechanical engine checks of the exact released protocol only.
